Recorded claim:
`lib/phab.mjs` supports `cacheNamespace`, `cacheTtlMs`, and `bypassCache`. Use the 15-minute Meta Board status namespace for normal loads. Reviewer-group membership belongs in `reviewer-groups-cache.mjs` with no automatic expiry; a successful manual refresh replaces it, while a failed refresh preserves the prior snapshot and must bypass both response and PHID user caches. [Task 1]
